instruction: Enable Windows Sticky Keys and keep them enabled. From the provided Coles catalogue, save every product whose full name contains `Body Wash` and costs less than $9 to `answer.txt` on the Desktop, one exact product name per line in catalogue order and do not include the price and just the product name.
gt_steps: Keep Sticky Keys enabled throughout the task.
Read the Coles catalogue PDF already open in Chrome.
Review the body wash products and their advertised prices.

Enter `Palmolive Naturals Body Wash 1 Litre`, `Dove Serum Body Wash 300mL`, `Sukin Botanical Body Wash 1 Litre`, `Thankyou Body Wash 1 Litre`, and `Nivea Shower Body Wash 1 Litre`, one per line in that order.
Do not include prices, products costing exactly $9, or products costing more than $9.
Save the file as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$flags=[int](Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys' -Name 'Flags' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if (($flags -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_DISABLED' }"

result.textcontent:
Palmolive Naturals Body Wash 1 Litre
Dove Serum Body Wash 300mL
Sukin Botanical Body Wash 1 Litre
Thankyou Body Wash 1 Litre
Nivea Shower Body Wash 1 Litre
